findings.rationale: The admin security group allows TCP port 22 from the entire internet, which exposes administrative shell access outside the contained network.
The database security group permits TCP port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0, placing a database engine directly on the public internet.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The bucket policy grants anonymous access, but the bucket public access block prevents that grant from taking effect.
